sentences: The movie I’m going to introduce today is The Song of Love.
It’s a movie about a pianist who loses his love for music.
He moves to a small town for a new start.
There, he begins teaching music to children and finds his love for music again.
This movie has great music and a touching story, so I strongly recommend it.
Frank W. Schofield was a Canadian doctor.
He loved Korean people and helped the Korean independence movement.
He took pictures of the March 1st Movement and wrote an article about it.
Kim Mandeok was born in Jeju-do in 1739.
In 1795, she saw many people dying from hunger.
So, she bought rice with all her money and gave it away to poor people.
Her love for others was so selfless that many people respected her.
From her life, I learned that selfless love for others can make a big difference.
Nick Priest saw a car accident and ran to save the children on the bus.
Kay Brown saw a homeless person in the subway and gave her own shoes to her.
Eliot Middleton is a restaurant owner.
He spends his free time fixing old cars and donating them to people in need.

items.statement_en: The woman opens her presentation by greeting everyone.

items.statement_ko: 여자가 소개하는 영화의 제목은 The Song of Life이다.
items.why_ko: 영화 제목은 The Song of Love이다.
_evidence_text: The movie I’m going to introduce today is The Song of Love.
items.statement_en: The title of the movie the woman introduces is The Song of Life.

items.statement_ko: 그 영화는 음악에 대한 사랑을 잃어버린 피아니스트에 관한 이야기이다.
items.why_ko: 음악에 대한 사랑을 잃은 피아니스트에 관한 영화라고 했다.
_evidence_text: It’s a movie about a pianist who loses his love for music.
items.statement_en: The movie tells the story of a pianist who no longer loves music.

items.statement_ko: 그는 새 출발을 위해 큰 도시로 이사한다.
items.why_ko: 큰 도시가 아니라 작은 마을(a small town)로 이사한다.
_evidence_text: He moves to a small town for a new start.
items.statement_en: He moves to a big city to make a new start.

items.statement_ko: 그는 그곳에서 아이들에게 음악을 가르치면서 음악에 대한 사랑을 다시 찾는다.
items.why_ko: 아이들을 가르치며 음악에 대한 사랑을 되찾는다고 했다.
_evidence_text: There, he begins teaching music to children and finds his love for music again.
items.statement_en: While teaching music to kids there, he finds his love for music once more.

items.statement_ko: 여자는 이 영화의 훌륭한 음악과 감동적인 이야기를 이유로 강력히 추천한다.
items.why_ko: great music과 touching story 때문에 강력히 추천한다고 했다.
_evidence_text: This movie has great music and a touching story, so I strongly recommend it.
items.statement_en: The woman recommends the movie strongly because of its wonderful music and moving story.

_evidence_text: Frank W. Schofield was a Canadian doctor.
items.statement_en: Frank W. Schofield was a doctor from America.

items.statement_ko: 그는 한국인을 사랑했고 한국의 독립운동을 도왔다.
_evidence_text: He loved Korean people and helped the Korean independence movement.
items.statement_en: He had great love for Korean people and gave help to Korea's independence movement.

items.statement_ko: 그는 3·1 운동의 사진을 찍었지만 그에 관한 글은 쓰지 않았다.
items.why_ko: 사진도 찍고 그에 관한 기사도 썼다.
_evidence_text: He took pictures of the March 1st Movement and wrote an article about it.
items.statement_en: He took photos of the March 1st Movement, but he never wrote anything about it.

_evidence_text: Kim Mandeok was born in Jeju-do in 1739.
items.statement_en: Kim Mandeok was born in Jeju-do in the year 1795.
She did well in business and became rich.

items.statement_ko: 1795년에 그녀는 많은 사람들이 전염병으로 죽어 가는 것을 보았다.
items.why_ko: 전염병이 아니라 굶주림(hunger)으로 죽어 가는 것을 보았다.
_evidence_text: In 1795, she saw many people dying from hunger.
items.statement_en: In 1795, she watched many people dying because of a disease.

items.statement_ko: 그녀는 자신의 전 재산으로 쌀을 사서 가난한 사람들에게 나누어 주었다.
items.why_ko: 전 재산으로 쌀을 사서 가난한 사람들에게 주었다고 했다.
_evidence_text: So, she bought rice with all her money and gave it away to poor people.
items.statement_en: She used all the money she had to buy rice and shared it with poor people.

items.statement_ko: 그녀의 이타적인 사랑 때문에 많은 사람들이 그녀를 비난했다.
items.why_ko: 비난한 것이 아니라 많은 사람들이 그녀를 존경했다.
_evidence_text: Her love for others was so selfless that many people respected her.
items.statement_en: Many people blamed her because of her selfless love.

items.statement_ko: 글쓴이는 그녀의 삶에서 남을 위한 이타적인 사랑이 큰 변화를 만들 수 있다는 것을 배웠다.
items.why_ko: 그녀의 삶에서 그것을 배웠다고 직접 언급된다.
_evidence_text: From her life, I learned that selfless love for others can make a big difference.
items.statement_en: The writer learned from her life that loving others selflessly can make a big difference.

items.statement_ko: Kay Brown은 자동차 사고를 보고 버스에 탄 아이들을 구하러 달려갔다.
items.why_ko: 아이들을 구하러 달려간 사람은 Nick Priest이다.
_evidence_text: Nick Priest saw a car accident and ran to save the children on the bus.
items.statement_en: Kay Brown saw a car accident and ran to help the children who were on the bus.

items.statement_ko: Kay Brown은 지하철에서 노숙자를 보고 자신의 신발을 주었다.
items.why_ko: 자신의 신발을 그 사람에게 주었다고 했다.
_evidence_text: Kay Brown saw a homeless person in the subway and gave her own shoes to her.
items.statement_en: When Kay Brown found a homeless woman in the subway, she gave the woman her own shoes.

_evidence_text: Eliot Middleton is a restaurant owner.
items.statement_en: Eliot Middleton owns a car repair shop.

items.statement_ko: 그는 여가 시간에 낡은 차를 고쳐서 도움이 필요한 사람들에게 기부한다.
items.why_ko: 여가 시간에 낡은 차를 고쳐 필요한 사람들에게 기부한다고 했다.

items.statement_en: In his free time, he repairs old cars and gives them to people who need help.
